title: Bill Uhouse: Kingman-based simulator and J-Rod

tellings.quote: who claimed at Area 51 auxiliary sites, there was basically a a ARV or extraterrestrial vehicle simulator built off the Kingman crash

plain: A man named Bill Uhouse claimed that at side sites of Area 51, a secret military test base in Nevada, a training simulator was built for flying an alien craft or a human-made copy of one, modeled on a craft from a reported crash at Kingman. The UFO researcher UAPGerb repeats Uhouse's claim, which also ties in with talk of a being called J-Rod. If true, it would mean people were being trained to fly recovered alien technology.
